notes.title: Roleplay Update - The Temple of Omniscius
notes.notes: Near the sacred Grove of Terraflora, workers began to gather, hauling wood and stone under the weight of a divine purpose. Rumors spread quickly that a temple to Omniscius, the All-Seeing God, was to be erected on the ancient grounds. As they dug deep into the earth, their tools struck something hard, revealing the weathered stone face of an ancient statue. As dust and dirt were brushed away, the unmistakable figure of the Archangel Raphael, Omniscius' revered son, came into view, his wings outstretched and his gaze fierce. The discovery sent whispers through the ranks of the workers, as if the heavens themselves had sanctioned the temple's creation, a sign that Omniscius' power would soon take root near the ancient Worldroot itself.

notes.title: New Update for Eo - Explore, Engage, and Experience Like Never Before!

Greetings, Adventurers!
We’re thrilled to announce a massive update to Eo, bringing a whole new level of depth and adventure to your experience. Delve into our latest features and prepare for an epic journey!

Venture into the unknown with an additional 5 km of richly detailed map. Discover new quests, secrets, and challenges in these uncharted lands.

notes.title: Never Give Up
notes.notes:
Greetings, brave adventurers of Eo!

We are thrilled to announce some major updates that will change the way you explore and battle in our mystical world. After much development and testing, we have partnered with Malbers and Microverse to bring you a new and improved movement and combat system, as well as procedurally generated terrains that will take your breath away.

With Malbers and Microverse, our terrains will be more immersive and dynamic than ever before, giving you endless possibilities to explore and discover hidden treasures. We can't wait for you to experience the thrill of exploring Eo in a whole new way.

But that's not all! We're also introducing horses and mounts, so you can traverse the world in style and speed. With a variety of mounts to choose from, you'll be able to ride into battle or simply gallop through the lush forests of Eo.

And to make your adventures even more seamless, we're updating our inventory system to make it more intuitive and user-friendly. Now you can focus on exploring and battling, without worrying about managing your gear.

We can't wait for you to dive into these exciting new changes and experience Eo like never before. Stay tuned for more updates and be ready to ride into adventure!

Please note that our networking is still not there yet, but we need your feedback on the movement, combat, inventory and everything else.

Best regards,
The Eo Team

notes.title: The State of Early Access #01
notes.notes:
As we near the half-year point of our Early Access phase, we wanted to take a moment to give you all an update on our progress and plans for the future. Your participation in the development of this game has been invaluable and your comments and bug reports are making a real difference in shaping the direction of the game. We cannot stress enough the impact your feedback has had on our priorities as we work to improve the game. We extend our heartfelt thanks to each and every one of you for being a part of this journey with us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680267/0c12b719c0e9ef71bf38e765f2e1f083db2106fc.png[/img]

We are still working on optimization so we can keep using this amazing lighting HDRP provides us and the perfect atmosphere for our roleplay sessions. 

We are dedicated to delivering the best possible gaming experience to all of our players, and we want to assure you that we are working tirelessly to make that a reality. As we continue our journey in Early Access, we promise to listen to your feedback and make changes that reflect the needs and wants of our community. You, the players, are at the heart of everything we do, and we want to thank you for your unwavering support.

A special thank you to all of our roleplayers who bring this world to life with your creativity and imagination. Your passion for this game is contagious and it is a privilege to have you all as part of our community. Thank you for your contributions and for helping us to create a rich and immersive world. notes.title: The New Eo
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/h1] 
after our first roleplay sessions, we understood that the main concerns were:
1- connection problems
2- movement and combat
3- inventory and saved characters issues
4- level up system
5- magic system

1- So, to address this, we changed from Photon Fusion to Photon PUN (a more reliable and stable networking solution). We've been playing for the last 2 months and we feel all the connectivity issues are in the past now. So, moving forward.
2- We implemented Opsive's Ultimate Character Controller and it's looking awesome. We had to tweak a bit to create a Flying Ability (important to us or our dear Ravenfolk and Fey would be grounded)
3- a lot of players were having problems with inventory and characters losing their data. We took some time off to find these problems and address them. They were being caused by our DM Client overriding player's data, now it's in the past.
4- A lot of you were asking for a level up system, but our level will be in your skills. So, we understand everyone wants to see the little "what's my level" up there, but look at your skills now. Train the skills you want to level up and their level will increase their use.
5- Magic in Eo is as before, but we improved the system to make it more.. explicit than before. You still need to figure out how to use magic, since it's a matter of knowledge in this world. Some people understand exactly what you need to push to cast a Fireball, others have no idea. So, if you're the second case, you need to find magic books that will explain it or maybe a tutor that knows how to cast spells. In time, with more players, maybe someone will even open a Magic School to teach people. We'll see. All the magic in Eo can be seen in your skills, since magic is also considered a skill here. The more skill points you have, more spells you'll be able to use.

notes.title: Stop and Breathe a Little
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680267/2cec48460ca3c3ad0c286d22ee7ccd42ce02b33a.png[/img]
Hello everyone, here's some things you've saying about Eo:

- Long load time
- Connection issues / lag
- Characters too slow
- No sound control / settings
- Areas too small

So, after gathering all the feedback, it's time to take a step back and re-start fresh. We're gathering everyone in the studio (that means 2 devs, 2 modelers and 1 illustrator) and we will tackle all the feedback we got from you guys. Focus on the negative reviews and what's wrong with the game. We'll take November and December to work on a massive overhaul and come up with something that will make all those negative reviews make no sense (we hope). 

So, let's hear what else you think should change about Eo to make it an amazing place for us roleplayers.

Here's some other issues we'll look into:

- Can't spawn too many animals, bad AI code, game lags.
- Hunting is not ok, skinning is terrible
- There's no indication of what you can gather (should be or not?)

To give everyone else a roleplay update about what happened when Eo was born:

- Redwood changed its name to Darkwood, the forest has been corrupted by Maeve and her followers, a temple was built to the goddess. Maeve created aberrations that make the forest a big threat.

- Luktharus found the corpse of a dead god, Lucifer. He formed a group called the Dark Monastery and is still trying to raise the god from the dead. Lucifer was killed by Eo when he tried to destroy humans and elves.

So, let's get ready to fix.

Write here what you think has to change to make this an alpha early access.

Roleplay Update

Tension has been brewing in the desert. An unfamiliar face arrived and the ravens embraced her. "Rayla, and all I need is a tent to study my book. I am a necromancer and I will join you if you'll have me."

notes.title: Performance Update and Mountains Pass Inn
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42680267/4fa33b5a908f7d612c0a5a4509fb90291edaca2e.png[/img]

The Mountains Pass Inn grows more each day. Its owner built a tanner and he has been seen working on leather armor. The fey have been whispering of a Dark Monastery (a group of men and demon working together), but nobody knows who they are or their plans.

We have been working tiredlessly to make everything perfect for everyone, adjusting movement synch (which was causing a clunky game), improving performance (some people were trying to sound smart by saying we don't have LODs or impostors, which you can clearly see in the game, so boo to them). We found this problem, found other problems and we keep finding problems every day. In spite of some shots that were taken, saying our player base is just family and friends (which is not far from the truth), our decision to release early stands. We play, we have fun with friends, amazing roleplaying has been going on and these negative reviews only make us stronger (which is also great). 

We are a small team with zero budget and zero funding, but we do have a dream - to make an awesome rpg where you can roleplay your character and change the world. Thank you all for making this dream come true!

notes.title: Hotfix #06
notes.notes:
Hello eollians (ugh, we need to work on that). Today we are still playing with optimization. Since our release our gods have printed these negative reviews, framed them and put them up on the wall as a reminder that game dev is not a joke. 

Anyway, we're slightly decreasing the grass textures (will make a big difference in performance) and we're trying a new Forced_LOD system that will work with Unity's LOD Group regular system.

We hope these changes will increase our holy FPS a little bit (and they did in testing), but we still need to hear from you, eonians (ugh).

notes.title: Hotfix #05
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Another update with some improvements to optimization and some work on the environment and LODs. 

- Mountains Pass Tavern is locked now, only opens when the owner is online.
- Improvements to LODs (more performance)
- Improvements to AI (perception sensor and distraction)

notes.title: Mountains Pass Tavern
notes.notes:
North Roads has never seen so much movement since the Divine Wars. A lone traveler opened the Mountains Pass Tavern, hoping he will offer shelter and ale to the passing wanderer. And in the mean time (yes, very mean), word is spreading of a new cult called the Dark Monastery forming around Redwood. Just a reminder to people: necromancy is a forbidden school and no one should practice it. Yeah, I know you'll do it anyway.

- We are still working to improve performance.
- New tests with Occlusion Culling to increase the framerate.
- Even smaller textures to render on objects far away
- We do not give up.

Love,

Samael, the Dark Prince

notes.title: Hotfix #04
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Thanks everyone that came to the world of Eo - roleplay was awesome last weekend. Anders and his followers already made a move to travel north and opened a path using the Exploration Camp. Anders also revealed to be a follower of Lucifer so that got everyone a bit worried.

- We are still working to make optimization great, we had problems (who doesn't) but we won't give up because Eo is our dream.
- More improvements should boost performance a bit with this upload.
- New area to the North (opened by Anders and his two followers)

notes.title: Hotfix #03 Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, our devs are still trying to improve optimization and performance without losing any of our beautiful shadows and reflections. 

We want to thank everyone that played the game, even those that made negative reviews and made our devs cry, because that made they work even harder to make the game better for you <3

- All background mountains baked into one mesh (improved performance)
- Post-processing adjustment (improved performance)

notes.title: Hotfix #02 Now live!
notes.notes: Hello everyone, we've got another hotfix addressing optimization and bugs. As many of you realized, we're running on HDRP (we're going for beautiful and social) which is definitely not ready for games. But since our experience goal is to be a slow-paced, social and beautiful atmosphere, HDRP is the way to go. We're doing our best to optimize so more people can join the fun :)

notes.title: Hotfix #01
notes.notes:
- Press any key (for players that didn't realize the game wasn't loading)
- Fixed issues with mesh baking
- Double check LODs (all good here)
- Double check imposters (all good here)

Thanks for all rpg lovers playing with us, means a lot. We appreciate the feedback, but also ask to understand we are not Larian or CdProjekt and we don't have 10 million dollars and a team of algorithm programmers optimizing. We are a team of 3 programmers struggling on zero budget. It's not an excuse, we ask a bit of patience. It will get better, and you all are helping us get there.

We also understand the concept is new to some people that just want to hop around killing things, in this case, maybe the game isn't for you really. The game is a slow paced, social experience, not supposed to be focused in combat (our combat system is absurdly simple: Ctrl, Raycast, Hit). But in time, even people that don't roleplay will feel attracted to it and we hope to convert a lot of people into roleplaying.

notes.title: Hotfix #00
notes.notes:
- Fixed problems with occlusion culling that were causing framerate to drop
- Fixed problems with perception sensor for animals that were also causing framerate to drop
- If framerate keeps dropping, we appreciate the feedback, we will change the perception sensor to something else. It's precise, but costly as is.

notes.title: Welcome to Eo
notes.notes:
Join us in our discord to help create a good background for your character and understand better how the game's going to work:

https://discord.gg/da5bwTSsCn

Feel free to post your background story in the #redwood channel, where everything begins. Use our channels only for in-character text and use our out-of-character channel for everything else.

Eo is not different, it's just made for specific people. It was created to be a roleplaying sandbox with living gods and deities that the players can worship. In Eo, you can only find power through the gods, so choose well who you're going to follow. 

Here, roleplaying is not optional. Players that don't roleplay their characters in Eo won't be banned, they'll just be killed and sent to Hades and the players that do roleplay their characters will become more powerful and gain roles in the world, even become deities and gods in the future if they are really good.

Let us know if you have questions about how everything works, but they will be answered faster in discord, which we use more. All the gods have been chosen, but when we have openings for new gods we will choose the best roleplayers (also, their ascension will be done in-game, through quests and roleplay).

We obviously have a lot of bugs to sort out, but the game will always be free, so just try to have fun! Remember, Eo is not a game made for combat, it's a social experience. So, if it's not your cup of tea, it's ok.

The dev team :)
